scripts.asm:fmt: npm run compile -- game/main.dasm -o rom/dave.original.bf && npm run compile -- --fmt rom/dave.original.bf
scripts.build:native: npm run asm && cargo build --release --manifest-path runners/native/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:web:min: npm run build:web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='dist/rom/dave.bf'; fs.writeFileSync(p, fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/[^><+\-.,[\]]/g,''));" && npx esbuild dist/runtime.js dist/vm.js dist/game/generated/level.js --minify --format=esm --outbase=dist --outdir=dist --allow-overwrite
scripts.run:native: npm run asm && cargo run --release --manifest-path runners/native/Cargo.toml -- rom/dave.bf
scripts.play:native: npm run asm && cargo run --release --manifest-path runners/native/Cargo.toml -- rom/dave.bf --window
scripts.play:terminal: npm run asm && cargo run --release --manifest-path runners/native/Cargo.toml -- rom/dave.bf --terminal
scripts.size: npm run asm && npm run compile -- --size
scripts.size:web:min: npm run build:web:min && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),z=require('zlib'),p=require('path');function files(d){return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const f=p.join(d,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?files(f):[f]})}let tr=0,tg=0;for(const f of files('dist')){const b=fs.readFileSync(f);const g=z.gzipSync(b,{level:9});tr+=b.length;tg+=g.length;console.log(f.replace(/\\/g,'/')+': '+b.length+' raw bytes, '+g.length+' gzip bytes')}console.log('total: '+tr+' raw bytes, '+tg+' gzip bytes')"
scripts.check: cargo check --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path runners/native/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run asm && npm run test:compiler && npm run test:native && npm run test:js
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web:min && wrangler pages deploy dist/ --project-name davefuck --branch main --commit-dirty=true
